target.title: fix: escape docs map heading markup
target.body:
Related: CodeQL alert #558

## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a problem where generated docs navigation could preserve malformed heading markup when docs headings contained HTML-like text.

## Why This Change Was Made

The docs map generator now escapes heading HTML characters before writing headings into Markdown instead of trying to strip tags. This keeps literal command placeholders like `<id>` visible while preventing malformed heading text from reintroducing markup into `docs/docs_map.md`.

## User Impact

Docs readers and agents get a generated docs map that preserves heading text accurately and treats embedded markup as text. There is no runtime product behavior change.

AI-assisted: yes, implemented with Codex.

## Evidence

- `pnpm format:fix -- scripts/generate-docs-map.mjs test/scripts/generate-docs-map.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/generate-docs-map.test.ts`
- `pnpm docs:map:check`
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local`
- Autoreview result: `autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported`
- `git diff --check`
